menus.name: SOLO X12 chef's table menu
menus.note: Eight surprise courses with wines included, at one table for 12; lunch Tuesday to Saturday at 12.45pm, dinner Tuesday to Friday at 7.45pm; no changes to the menu

bookingOpens: Online through Plateform from the restaurant's website (one booking page for the tasting menus, another for the chef's table), or by phone or email.
groups: For more than six guests, email info@casaperbellini.com or call. At tables of more than four everyone must choose the same tasting menu, and à la carte is not available.
dressCode: No strict dress code, but elegant or smart casual is suggested. No shorts or flip-flops.
children: The chef's table is for adults only. No animals, however small.
